content.short: Cookbook is a search engine for EVM smart contracts and open source.
content.description: Cookbook is a community-sourced collection of smart contracts for developers to download code and use as they prefer. Users can browse a growing number of smart contracts by searching use cases or blockchains. Developers can offer new contracts, contribute to quality-checking existing contracts, and add support for more chains through a Discord community. Cookbook also supports Metis, Cronos, Ethereum Classic, Aurora, Fantom, Fuse, Milkomeda, Boba, Moonbeam, and Moonriver.
